title: Son's Island

blurb: Guests reserve a private waterfront cabana on a 3.5-acre island with a private dock and swim ladder. Activities include kayaking, paddleboarding, swimming, rope swing, frog slide, sand volleyball, fishing, and grilling. Cabana rentals include amenities like hammock, picnic table, charcoal BBQ pit, electricity, fan, and running water.
extraNote: A cabana rental is required to enter Son's Island · Rates shown are average summer pricing; spring and fall are typically lower, holiday weekends higher · Drive across the 100-foot wooden bridge onto the private island on Lake Placid. · Open daily, reopened Spring 2026
